original_description: Pika's creation apps in your chat: product ads, studio headshots, short films, photo animation, relighting, new camera angles, outfit swaps, lip-sync, soundtracks and more. Pick an app from the gallery or describe what you want, upload your photos and clips, and keep building on earlier results.
summary_ja: 写真や動画をもとに広告、短編映像、人物写真、音楽などを制作・編集する。
limitations: クレジット消費への言及あり。料金や利用条件、実際の機能は未検証。
